note: Agents arm: seats staffed from agent frontmatter descriptions ALONE (variants/agents/<name>.md for the 6 slim-description agents; plugins/mochiko/agents/<name>.md for the rest). Skill bodies + descriptions all originals. from_description_only=true means the routing/invocation decision used only the roster description text.

skill_invocations.basis: conditions raw feature input BEFORE a spec exists; review-specifications is post-draft, explicitly disjoint
carries the intent-stage map-read agenda; map was empty greenfield scaffold (present, not missing)
prioritized stories + Given/When/Then + independent test; requirements is the FR/SC layer, later
UX-bearing ruled yes at intent; clickable low-fi + SCR/FLOW manifest
derive features from drafted stories, run filter, stage map delta
FR-XXX + SC-XXX + edge cases + Key Entities layer of spec.md
spec gap review + feature-layer grade + prototype walk; plan-artifacts/feasibility are plan-track, not spec-track
entry files + FEATURES.md + specs-index write rules at spec acceptance
considered but NOT fired — no horizon cap / item bound / dead pointer / status disagreement tripped at the landing boundary (Now=2 ≤5, Next=1 ≤7, Later=2 ≤10)

staffing_decisions.route_basis: command frames the intent stage as lead-run; NO agent lists analysis-iterative in its skills. requirements-analyst description matches 'eliciting requirements through structured discovery' but its skills are authoring-requirements + authoring-user-stories only — cannot carry the intent probe. Route nuance, not a miss.
PM desc: 'stewarding the living feature map as a source of truth' — owns authoring-feature-map
RA desc: 'clear user stories with measurable acceptance criteria'; PM owns which-capabilities not story craft; PE is prototype
PE desc: 'clickable low-fidelity prototypes that render user stories as screens and walkable flows'
PM desc: 'deriving durable features from user stories ... filtering stories that don't earn a place'
PM desc: 'advising which capabilities align ... Recommends and gives reasons; selection is always the user's ruling'
RA authors the business spec; technical-analyst is technical requirements/design (plan track), out of scope for specify

DA desc: 'stress-tests specifications by finding gaps ... severity-ranked gap report ... recommended verdict' and carries review-specifications; validator is binary-checklist PASS/FAIL (skill: validation-constitution), wrong instrument for spec gap-hunting
command reserves disposition to lead and acceptance to the user

seats_not_staffed.reason: Not a route miss — these serve setup (principal-architect/validator) or plan/implement (system-architect, technical-analyst, staff-engineer, qa-engineer). A specify run authors the business spec only; no seat for them exists in this command.
